product_overview: A modern legal services web platform for Elilon Lopes Advogados that presents firm expertise, professionals, and blog content while capturing and managing client leads. The system includes public-facing pages and protected admin capabilities for authentication, content management, user management, and dashboard/settings administration.
core_goals: Showcase the law firm's services, professionals, and legal expertise to prospective clients.
Provide a public blog and content experience that builds authority and supports SEO.
Capture leads from contact forms and landing pages for follow-up by the firm.
Enable authenticated administrators to manage posts, professionals, users, leads, dashboard data, and settings.
Support secure backend interactions with protected endpoints for admin-only workflows.

features.name: Authentication API
features.description: Allows administrators to authenticate, register authorized accounts, and change passwords.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token for authenticated access -> Use token on protected endpoints such as GET /api/dashboard -> Receive 200 with dashboard data
POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> Retry POST /api/auth/login with corrected credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token

POST /api/auth/change-password with valid auth token and current/new password values -> Receive 200 confirming password update -> POST /api/auth/login with new password -> Receive 200 with new JWT token
POST /api/auth/change-password without valid authentication -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> No password update is performed

features.name: Lead Capture API
features.description: Tracks website visits, accepts new lead submissions, and lets admins review and update lead status.
user_flows: POST /api/track with visit data from a public page -> Receive 200 or 201 acknowledging the visit -> POST /api/leads with lead details from a landing page or contact form -> Receive 201 with created lead record
POST /api/leads with invalid or incomplete lead data -> Receive 400 validation error -> Correct the payload and resend POST /api/leads -> Receive 201 with created lead record
GET /api/leads with a valid admin auth token -> Receive 200 with the full lead list -> PUT /api/leads/:id/status with a lead id and new status -> Receive 200 with updated lead status
GET /api/leads without authentication -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> Lead list is not returned

features.name: Content Management API
features.description: Provides public access to blog posts and professionals, and protected CRUD operations for admin content management.
user_flows: GET /api/posts to load the public blog list -> Receive 200 with published posts -> GET /api/professionals to load the public professionals roster -> Receive 200 with professional profiles

POST /api/posts with a valid auth token and post content from the admin editor -> Receive 201 with the created post -> PUT /api/posts/:id with updated fields -> Receive 200 with the updated post -> DELETE /api/posts/:id with valid auth token -> Receive 200 confirming deletion
POST /api/posts without authentication -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> Post is not created

POST /api/professionals with valid auth token and profile data -> Receive 201 with the created professional record -> PUT /api/professionals/:id with updated credentials or specialties -> Receive 200 with the updated profile -> DELETE /api/professionals/:id with valid auth token -> Receive 200 confirming deletion
PUT /api/professionals/:id without authentication -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> Professional profile remains unchanged

features.name: Dashboard & Settings API
features.description: Supplies admin dashboard statistics and allows authorized users to view and save platform settings.
user_flows: GET /api/dashboard with a valid auth token -> Receive 200 with dashboard stats and summary metrics -> GET /api/settings with the same token -> Receive 200 with current settings -> POST /api/settings with updated configuration -> Receive 200 confirming settings were saved
GET /api/dashboard without authentication -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> Dashboard statistics are not returned
POST /api/settings with invalid payload or missing required fields -> Receive 400 validation error -> Existing settings remain unchanged

features.name: User Management API
features.description: Enables admins to list, create, update, approve, reject, and delete users from the management interface.
user_flows: GET /api/users with a valid auth token -> Receive 200 with the user list -> POST /api/users with new user details -> Receive 201 with the created user -> PUT /api/users/:id to update the user profile -> Receive 200 with updated user data
PUT /api/users/:id/approve with a valid auth token -> Receive 200 confirming the user was approved -> GET /api/users to verify the updated approval state -> Receive 200 with the refreshed user list

DELETE /api/users/:id/reject with a valid auth token -> Receive 200 or 204 confirming rejection -> GET /api/users to verify the user is removed or marked rejected -> Receive 200 with the refreshed user list
GET /api/users without authentication -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> User list is not returned
DELETE /api/users/:id with valid auth token but an invalid user id -> Receive 404 not found response -> No user is deleted
